decision: The standalone state machine validates that long-lived proven ownership can improve the concentrated common-five scope, but its self-improvement proof over-promotes campaigns in broad universes and destroys union/removal wealth. Do not tune price or alpha margins around the proof rule.
next_root_cause: Compounder proof needs a cross-sectional leadership property, not merely own-price and own-alpha improvement. The broad scopes prove roughly twice as many campaigns as common-five, consistent with over-promotion rather than insufficient holding.
evidence_readback: Dedicated hosted workflow completed TDD, source-bound measurement, artifact upload, research/evidence append and remote SHA read-back successfully.
